name: document card
description: Navigation or tab card: icon, title, description, and optional tags; the entire card is linkable. Tiles are grid cards and rows are compact list rows.
scenarios: “Next” at the end of the page recommends 2–3 pages
Provide several entrance paths according to the reader's situation
List a set of options or resources side by side

boundaries: Used for navigation and side-by-side options; use doc-compare when you need item-by-item comparison capabilities.
The icon only accepts emoji or one or two characters. Images cannot be passed in.

usage.purpose: Let readers quickly choose their next step among several paths or pages.
structure: Tile: icon block, title, description, upper right corner label; when there is href, the entire card is a link, and an arrow appears when hovering.
Row: One item per row, icon on the left, title and description in the middle, and arrow on the right.
Cards in the same row are of equal height; single column below 640px.

inputs.meaning: The number of columns is 2, 3 or 4; 4 columns will become 2 columns below 820px, and all columns will be single column below 640px.

omission.description: tile: 2 columns when there are 4 cards, otherwise the smaller value of the number of cards and 3 is used; row: 2 columns when there are more than 3 items, otherwise 1 column.

inputs.meaning: tile grid card or row compact list row.
Emoji icons placed in squares with light background.
The card title is recommended to be no more than 12 Chinese characters.

One or two sentences of explanation, no more than 50 Chinese characters recommended. Inline tags: **bold**,`代码`, [text] (link); links can be written ashttps://…or doc:slug#anchor. When the card itself has an href, the link in the description only displays text.
Link to the entire card:https://…or doc:slug#anchor.

omission.description: Cards are not links and do not display arrows.

inputs.meaning: Short tags, such as "recommended" and "new", are recommended to be no more than 4 Chinese characters.
Icon background color, label and hover border color: brand | teal | warm | violet | rose | slate.

recipes.title: "Next" at the end of the page
steps: Use variant row or 3 column tiles.
Explain what the writing reader can accomplish on that page.

interactions.action: Click or press Enter to open the card
interactions.effect: Open the link; the document link opens within the site.

constraints: Read-only display, page data will not be modified.
2–6 cards recommended; no more than 12 Chinese characters for the title and no more than 50 Chinese characters for the description.

data: Add or delete cards, modify text and links.
implementation: Extend the variant enumeration and release a new version when a new variant is added.

entryPoints.purpose: Components, column inference, md() and readData.
Token, tile/row layouts and narrow screen rules.

architecture: The number of grid columns is written to the CSS variable --cols; the tint is set via the tone-* classes --t/--ts.
Cards with href are rendered as <a>, internal links are downgraded to text, and nested links are avoided.
extensionPoints: columnsFor() determines the default number of columns.
invariants: The component does not call onChange.
verification: Check out the 2/3/4 column and row variants at 1000px, 390px width and dark theme.
The focus box is visible when tabbing into a card.
